_schema_note: Economy source of truth (JSON mirror of economy.md), reorganized 2026-09-27. Statuses: LOCKED (Beth-decided, dated), DEFAULT (launch value, Beth may retune), TBD (open). Nothing invented.

_stale_name_mapping.gems: rejected name, never use (gemstone names reserved for side games)

laws: No ads of any kind, not even rewarded opt-in. IAP only.
Premium currency is Crowns; soft currency is coins.
Time always earns the same rewards as money; money strictly expedites.
Plot is never time-gated; energy is the only throttle.
No VS mode; no PvP leagues - solo society-rank ladder.
No avatar unlocks - outfits, hair, accessories only.
Scoring shows categories only; weights hidden. Six canonical categories: occasion fit, silhouette, palette, material, restraint + rotating editorial.
The Gazette is judge and narrator, never a paywall or notification feed.
Storyline advancement costs coins, never Crowns.
Free to finish, faster to fund.

order_generator.rule: The merge board always carries open orders: up to 10 standing order slots (DEFAULT); when a slot empties, the generator deals a new random order after a short delay (DEFAULT: 5 minutes).
order_generator.difficulty_spread: Orders span easy to hard (DEFAULT: a mix of low-, mid-, and high-tier requests); payouts scale with tier (commissions round(2*tier*3.0), custom orders round(2*tier*1.0)).
order_generator.reachability_guarantee: Every generated order obeys the reachability guarantee: it never requests an item the player could not merge into existence with unlimited time and energy — unlocked chains only, always producible.
order_generator.payouts: Authored story commissions sit alongside generated custom orders; payouts unchanged.
order_generator.design_note: The order queue is the free player's income engine: board play funds the story.
